correctness.rationale: Lemma 1 enumerates all atomic possibilities for e,x,y in ternary multiplication; Lemma 2 uses unique inverse of squaring for odd exponent p and covers p=2,3 separately. Lemma 3 proves exact generic-witness cutoffs p=2,3,5,>=7, uniformly for nonabelian groups. Explicit separating rank <=2 sentences and group order divisibility prove exactly six theories, with optimal global size 9 from C3^2. Independent exhaustive atomic computations on abelian and nonabelian finite calibration examples agree. No finite test is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: All finite groups of prime exponent form a natural class encompassing nonabelian group families; the complete logical classification and sharp cutoff expose a genuine expressivity boundary. The non-obvious equivalence C5^2 ≡_2 C7 and every nonabelian exponent-5 group ≡_2 C7 give motivated structural insights rather than a single arbitrary computation.
